holdout_rule: NEVER used for selection; evaluate once after pick
select_rule: utc_date <= select_end only; Nov-Dec 2025 is confirm, not selection

clock.note: Gold clock unchanged. New family is exit/risk, not a new event.

costs.slippage_notes: UNMEASURED explicit assumption. Same book as v1 gold scalp.

grid.note: 16 cells. tp_r=0.35 is the WR-trap cell (cost-adjusted breakeven at 80% WR needs tp_r>=0.37 on this ATR/cost).

score.eligible: n>=40 and pf>=1.0 and payoff>=0.22 and wr_not_degenerate
score.degenerate: payoff<0.22 (one loser wipes >=5 winners) unless pf>1.2 and max_dd bounded — still reject payoff<0.20
score.if_none_eligible: no 80pct winner; honest_book = max pf among n>=30; do not pick by confirm or holdout

wr80_grill.target: develop_or_select WR>=0.80 and PF>=1.0 after costs
wr80_grill.math: net_win=tp_r*S-c; net_loss=S+c; at WR=0.80 need tp_r >= (c/S+0.20)/0.80. S~2.6 USD ATR, c~25 USD => tp_r>=0.37
wr80_grill.trap: tight TP + wide SL can print WR>=80 with PF<1; that is a FAIL

autopsy_prior_family.diagnosis: SL/TP race on M5 noise; flatten never matters; London and NY equally negative
